_comment: STAGING (https://zedv3.qci.org.in, docs/STAGING.md). Copy to the staging server (e.g. E:\ZedV4\settings.json), fill in, restrict to administrators, never commit the filled copy. Same structure as settings.example.json: keys are environment variable names (':' becomes '__'); sections merge Common, then Portals or Mobile, then the application's own section. Install with -EnvironmentName Staging. Staging is for testing (and may later hold a copy of production data): every mail is redirected, payments use the CCAvenue TEST gateway, partner APIs and ERP stay off, Zed.Jobs schedules stay off. Storage roots point at a staging COPY of the folders, never at the production share. On the staging VM (20.219.21.200) D: is the Azure TEMPORARY disk (wiped on redeploy): everything lives on E: or a data disk; Install-ZedIis.ps1 refuses the temporary disk. Databases: the V4 set built from scratch with the prefix ZEDV4_ on the server's own SQL Server 2025 Express instance (ZEDV4_ZEDCS_V2_LIVE, ZEDV4_ZED_CONSULTANT, ZEDV4_ZED_SURVEILLANCE, ...; docs/STAGING.md 3.0), never the older ZED databases on that instance. Connection strings use integrated security: each app pool identity (IIS APPPOOL\ZedV4-...) and the Zed.Jobs service account has a Windows login with the least-privilege roles (database/security/01 with @AuthMode = 'WINDOWS' and @DatabasePrefix = N'ZEDV4_'), so there are no database passwords. Database__Prefix=ZEDV4_ makes the few inline queries that name another database (ZED_CONSULTANT.dbo....) use the prefixed names too; the hosts refuse it in Production. Everything is on E: (install E:\ZedV4, keys E:\ZedV4\keys, storage E:\ZedStaging).

Common._Email_comment: Decided: every staging mail goes to dev.zed@qcin.org (portals and mobile API here; Zed.Jobs in its own section below). Do not add Email__AllowedRecipientDomains: with it, mail to those domains would go to the real recipients. The hosts refuse to start in Staging when neither setting is given.

Portals._Recaptcha_comment: Use a separate reCAPTCHA v2 key pair registered for zedv3.qci.org.in (not the production keys): the captcha is then exercised without production secrets on this server. Recaptcha__Enabled=false is the fallback if no staging key is registered: login and registration then skip the captcha, so that part goes untested. App registration (Msme/ValidateCaptcha) uses the app's built-in Android site key, whose secret is AppSecretKey: give it only on rehearsal days, or the app's registration test stops at the captcha.

Mobile._comment: The mobile hosts refuse to start outside Production while these still name loginzed.msme.gov.in.

Main._comment: IIS application /. Consultancy and Surveillance connections: opened read-only by the host (read intent), with the app pool's own Windows login (database/security/01). Storage: a copy of the production folders on the staging server.
Main._CcAvenue_comment: CCAvenue TEST account and keys only (never the production merchant on staging). Ask CCAvenue to allow https://zedv3.qci.org.in for the test merchant's return URLs ({PublicBaseUrl}/api/payments/ccavenue/response, .../surveillance-response, .../consultancy-response).

Consultancy._comment: IIS application /Consultancy. StorageRoot: the same staging copy as main's.

Surveillance._comment: IIS application /surveillance. StorageRoot: the same staging copy as main's.

MobileMain._comment: IIS application /mobileapi. StorageRoot: the staging copy of the old services folder (Photos, SaPhotos, Videos). Consultancy connection: read-only, for the TU documents.

ZedJobs._comment: NOT read by Install-ZedIis.ps1: environment of the Zed.Jobs Windows service on staging (docs/JOBS.md 'Running it'). Leave every Jobs:Schedules entry and Jobs:FolderRename disabled (the shipped appsettings.json has them off); the mail worker may run, and then sends only to dev.zed@qcin.org.
